chunks: And when the people take their places at Minā, a caller from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, calls out: “If you desire that I be pleased, then I have indeed become pleased.”

key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Minā, the sacred hajj location
key_terms.رَضِيتُ: I am pleased, expressing divine acceptance
key_terms.مَوَاطِنَهُمْ: their places or stations where they settle
key_terms.مِنْ قِبَلِ اللَّهِ: from Allah, indicating a divine proclamation

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about Allah’s pleasure with pilgrims at Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a divine proclamation made when the pilgrims settle in their places at Minā during hajj. It conveys Allah’s pleasure with them, highlighting the spiritual virtue and acceptance associated with this sacred rite.
